name: agent-bom
description: Inventory and audit your AI estate: scan MCP servers, agents and packages for CVEs, supply-chain risk and exposed credentials; audit MCP configs and skills for injection and risky grants; check a server before you add it; plan fixes. Read-only by default and local.

interface.longDescription: Scan the MCP servers, agents and packages on this machine for CVEs, known-exploited and malicious packages, and exposed credentials. Inventory the AI estate, audit MCP configs and skill files for prompt injection and risky grants, vet a package before you add it, and get an ordered fix plan. Runs locally from a pinned PyPI release; read-only by default; no account or API key.
defaultPrompt: Scan my MCP servers and agents for vulnerabilities and exposed credentials
Audit my MCP configuration for risky servers
Is this package safe to add before I install it?
